review_candidates.title: After Sales Support Engineer
review_candidates.company: TIANYI Telecom; Sichuan Tianyi Comheart Telecom Co., Ltd.
review_candidates.description: Sichuan Tianyi Comheart Telecom Co., Ltd. is a High-Tech enterprise specializing in the R&D, production and sales of telecommunication equipment. Our products cover optical telecommunication terminals, wireless telecommunication devices, and smart terminals. Headquartered in Chengdu, Sichuan Province, China, we have over 3,000 employees and annual sales revenue exceeding $350 million. Our products and services are widely used in multiple countries and regions globally. Due to business expansion in Egypt, we are hiring two After-Sales Service Engineers to provide technical support and services for Egypt for network communication equipment and optical terminal products. Work Location Cairo, Egypt (may needs frequent travel within Egypt required based on project needs) Key Responsibilities 1. Technical Support & Maintenance: Provide on-site technical support for equipment installation, debugging, maintenance, and troubleshooting to ensure optimal performance. 2. Equipment Monitoring & Optimization: Regularly inspect equipment status, analyze system performance, and propose optimization strategies to ensure stability. 3. Rapid Response & Problem Solving: Address technical issues promptly via remote or on-site support to maximize customer satisfaction. 4. Client Communication & Needs Analysis: Maintain strong client relationships, identify customer needs, and deliver tailored solutions. 5. Upgrades & Training: Assist clients with equipment upgrades and configuration adjustments, and provide technical training. 6. Documentation: Prepare technical reports and service records, and provide internal feedback on solutions. Qualifications Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher in Electronics, Communication Engineering, Computer Science Language: Fluency in Arabic and English ( both spoken and written) for effective technical communication ( Chinese is an advantage) Skills: Strong customer service mindset, teamwork, problem solving and adaptability. Driving license: Valid driver's license for travel and on-site support. Preferred experience with Network Communication Devices or Optical Terminal Products. We offer Competitive salary and performance bonuses Comprehensive training programs Career growth opportunities in an international environment.

review_candidates.title: Technical Support English | Customer Follow-Up | Morning shift
review_candidates.description: Company Description ETISAL International Group is a leading Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) company serving clients across the Middle and Far East. The organization focuses on delivering customized, high-value outsourcing solutions that address each client’s specific business needs and help them concentrate on their core operations. With deep attention to cultural differences and industry best practices, ETISAL International provides services designed to enhance customer experience and operational performance. The company emphasizes transparency, flexibility, integrity, and a strong commitment to quality, human capital, and advanced technologies. ETISAL International continually works to exceed client expectations through passionate service and ongoing improvement of its management and operational standards. Role Description The Technical Support English | Customer Follow-Up | Morning shift role is a full-time, on-site position based in Qesm El Maadi. The role involves providing technical support in English to customers, responding to inquiries, and resolving issues related to products and services. Daily responsibilities include troubleshooting technical problems, documenting cases, and performing follow-up calls or messages to ensure customer issues are fully resolved and satisfaction is maintained. The team member will handle customer interactions through various communication channels, escalate complex cases when needed, and adhere to established service-level agreements and quality standards. Collaboration with colleagues and supervisors to improve support processes and share knowledge is also part of the role. Qualifications Huawei English Technical Support Agents • Outbound Follow Up Requirements: ▪️ Graduates -Technical graduates are preferred ▪️ English Level: B2 Details: ▪️ Salary: 12500 up to 15000 ▪️ Fixed Shift: 9 AM – 6 PM ▪️ 2 Days Off (Rotational) ▪️ Social & Medical Insurance ▪️ Paid Training ▪️ Location: Maadi

review_candidates.title: Furniture Sales Engineer
review_candidates.description: At Belong: Join our dynamic team at Belong, a prominent One-Stop-Shop e-commerce platform specialized in furniture and home supplies. At Belong, we're dedicated to providing a unique and exceptional shopping experience, making it simpler for individuals to create a better home and living space that truly reflects their values. As a part of our team, you'll contribute to our commitment to customer obsession and delivering exceptional products and service. If you're passionate about innovation, quality, and customer satisfaction, belong is the place for you to thrive and make a lasting impact in the e-commerce landscape. Join us on this exciting journey! Responsibilities: Manage B2B and B2C sales. Understand client’s vision and interpret into the suitable selection with focus on furniture, carpet, lighting, artwork and accessories. Communicate with clients online and offline, prepare financial proposals, and follow up on orders. Coordinate with production, marketing and finance departments. Develop 2D plans and mood boards when necessary. confirm orders with customers and prepare their job orders for production and sourcing. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in a related design field. 1-4 years of sales and design experience. Excellent command of English lalanguage. Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. Proficiency in AutoCAD and Photoshop; 3D Max is a plus. Preferred experience in the furniture industry. Creative with strong design and presentation skills. Initiative-driven with project management abilities. Meticulous, team player, able to work under pressure. Excellent problem-solving skills. Location: Maadi, Cairo. If interested, Kindly Send your updated CV to hello@shopbelong.com with the subject "Sales Engineer."
